title: AISTATS 2027 Journal-to-Conference Track
institution: AISTATS 2027 (International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics)
about: The AISTATS 2027 Journal-to-Conference track accepts submissions until 18 January 2027 (AoE). AISTATS 2027 takes place 3-6 May 2027 in Montreal, Canada; main-track paper deadlines have already passed.
requirements: Main-track abstract and paper deadlines (29 September and 6 October 2026) have passed; only the Journal-to-Conference track remains open
2027 track eligibility rules are to be posted separately by the organisers

upskill.name: Machine Learning & Predictive Modelling II
why: Skill "Machine learning" -> objective "Combine multiple predictive models through ensemble methods and model stacking to improve robustness and predictive performance."

Skill "Statistics" -> objective "Evaluate models using appropriate validation strategies, cross-validation procedures, and generalisation principles to reduce overfitting and obtain credible performance estimates."
